mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive, but S&P 500 returns remain negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate remains below 3.5%, but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the unemployment rate is below 4%, it indicates a tight monetary policy stance, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate remains above 2% and unemployment below 4%, but the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which should positively impact related sectors and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase, but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which should lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Industrial production increases, but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Retail sales increase, but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index is above target and the federal funds rate is low, it may indicate inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPI remains above target and FEDFUNDS stays low, but the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate in a late-cycle expansion indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate remains low, but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods.
